Privacy Notice

How SalesTrack collects, uses and protects personal data shared through this website, and how you can exercise your rights.

Version 3 · Last updated: 13 November 2026

1. Who we are

This website (salestrack.co.in) is operated by SalesTrack, Daffodil, 5th Floor, Opposite Sahas Cricket Club, Nagpur, Maharashtra 440015, India. SalesTrack decides why and how your personal data is processed. Under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (the "DPDP Act"), this makes us the Data Fiduciary.

Contact for data protection questions: info@salestrack.co.in (subject line "Privacy request").

2. What we collect and why

Personal dataWhy we use itBasisHow long we keep it
Enquiry form or email: name, email address, phone number, company name, service of interest and messageTo reply to your enquiry, discuss the service you asked about and prepare a proposalYour consent, given by ticking the consent box or by emailing usUntil your enquiry is resolved; longer only if you become a client or the law requires it
Your choice about marketing updatesTo send occasional updates about our services, only if you opted inYour separate, optional consentUntil you unsubscribe or withdraw consent
A record of your consent (the notice version and the date and time, saved with your enquiry record)To show that you gave consent, as the DPDP Act requiresLegal obligationFor as long as we hold the enquiry it relates to

When you submit the enquiry form, your details are sent over an encrypted connection to our enquiry records, which are kept in Google Sheets. We then send you a confirmation email and notify our team by email. Nothing is stored on the website itself. We do not sell personal data, and we do not use it for automated decision-making or profiling.

3. Cookies and tracking

This website does not use cookies, analytics, advertising trackers, social media plug-ins or browser storage, and it loads no content from other websites. Our hosting provider processes basic technical data, such as IP addresses, to deliver and secure the website (see section 5).

4. Your consent and how to withdraw it

We ask for your consent before you send an enquiry, and marketing updates have a separate, optional box that is never pre-ticked. You can withdraw consent at any time, as easily as you gave it, by emailing info@salestrack.co.in. Withdrawal does not affect processing that took place before it. After you withdraw, we stop processing your data for that purpose and delete it unless the law requires us to keep it. If you withdraw consent for your enquiry, we will no longer be able to respond to it.

5. Who we share it with

We share personal data only with service providers that help us run our business, and only as far as needed:

  • Email hosting: GoDaddy hosts our business email, so enquiry emails are stored on its servers on our behalf.
  • Enquiry records and emails: Google (Google Sheets and Google Apps Script) stores enquiry records and sends the confirmation and notification emails on our behalf.
  • Website hosting: GitHub (GitHub Pages) hosts this website and processes technical connection data, such as IP addresses, to deliver and secure it, under its own privacy terms.

These providers may store data outside India. We may also disclose personal data where the law requires it.

6. How we protect it

This website is served only over an encrypted connection (HTTPS). We take reasonable security safeguards to protect personal data in our possession, as the law requires. If a personal data breach affects you, we will inform you and the Data Protection Board of India as the law requires.

7. How long we keep it and when we delete it

We keep personal data only for as long as needed for the purpose it was collected for, as set out in section 2. We delete it when that purpose is fulfilled or you withdraw consent, whichever comes first, unless the law requires us to keep it longer.

8. Your rights

Under the DPDP Act you have the right to:

  • Access: get a summary of the personal data we hold about you and how we use it;
  • Correction and erasure: have your data corrected, completed, updated or deleted;
  • Withdraw consent at any time (section 4);
  • Grievance redressal: have a complaint about how we handle your data resolved by us;
  • Nominate another person to exercise your rights in the event of your death or incapacity.

How to make a request: email info@salestrack.co.in with the subject line "Privacy request" and tell us which right you want to exercise. We may ask you for information to confirm your identity. We will respond as soon as possible and in any case within 90 days.

9. Complaints

Please contact us first so we can try to resolve your concern. If you are not satisfied with our response, you can complain to the Data Protection Board of India.

If you are in the United Kingdom or the European Union, you may also have rights under the UK GDPR or EU GDPR, including the right to complain to your local data protection authority (in the UK, the Information Commissioner's Office).

10. Your duties

When you share personal data with us, the DPDP Act asks you to give accurate information, not to impersonate anyone, and not to file false or frivolous complaints.

11. Children

Our services are for businesses. This website is not intended for anyone under 18, and we do not knowingly collect their personal data. If we learn that we have received a child's personal data without verifiable parental consent, we will delete it.

12. Language and changes to this notice

This notice is in English. If you would like it in another language listed in the Eighth Schedule to the Constitution of India, email us and we will help. We may update this notice from time to time; the latest version and its date will always be on this page.
